testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-account-association.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-31697 admin assigns a sales rep to a new account

scenario.summary: The admin creates a new account on store A, selects the store's sales rep in the Sales Rep lookup and saves; Manage Account shows the account with that sales rep.
steps: Go to Accounts and Users > Accounts > Add Account.
Fill the required account details (account name and code made up by the test); select store A (@storeA.name).
Click the Sales Rep search icon, search @rep.fullName and select it; save the account.
Open Manage Account of the new account.
stateChanges: Creates an account on store A with Sales Rep @rep (created by the test; the test deletes it at the end).
assertions: The account is saved (success message, read from the page)
evidence: Story Z10-38546 (SalesRep - Phase 2, account association), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-38546/analysis.md sections 3-4 and answers in section 6.
FSD section 2 (Add Account: Sales Rep search lookup) and section 3 (the Sales Rep field on Manage Account).
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A), as in the Phase 1 tests.
The new account is a state change of the test (analysis section 3), not a need.
DOUBT: the save message text is not fixed by the FSD; read it from the page.
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.
